error: Chapter, commentary and other reads stalled for seconds while the index build, dictionary export or a search ran
fix: Library keeps a small pool of idle connections per module; with() takes one out, runs the query with no lock held, and puts it back

error: Journal edits lost when switching entries within 600ms of typing

root_cause: one shared debounce timer; persist() for the next entry cleared the previous entry's pending save

detail: Ref/Strong's hover popup opens after mouse left and never closes
error: Ref/Strong's hover popup opens after mouse left and never closes
fix: generation ref bumped on every hover change/hide; result dropped if it changed
root_cause: hide cleared only the delay timer, not a fetch already in flight; popup has pointerEvents none so no mouseout closes it

detail: Read chapter aligned against previous chapter's Strong's text
error: Read chapter aligned against previous chapter's Strong's text
fix: clear strongVerses at effect start
root_cause: strongVerses only cleared in the non-KJV branch, not at chapter change

detail: Strong's hover shows old lexicon's entry or nothing after lexicon change/failure
error: Strong's hover shows old lexicon's entry or nothing after lexicon change/failure
fix: clear cache when effect reruns; drop null results from cache

detail: Palette verse preview shows text for an earlier query
error: Palette verse preview shows text for an earlier query

root_cause: passages fetch had no stale guard

detail: Journal entry lost if saving failed partway after its date moved to another month
error: Journal entry lost if saving failed partway after its date moved to another month
fix: save writes the destination month first, then removes the entry from any other month
root_cause: journal::save removed the entry from the old month file before writing the new one

detail: Text added to a journal month file in Obsidian vanished on the next save from the app (notes above the first entry, entries with a damaged id comment, a body line starting with *)
error: Text added to a journal month file in Obsidian vanished on the next save from the app (notes above the first entry, entries with a damaged id comment, a body line starting with *)
fix: Saving splices: only the affected entry's lines are replaced or removed, everything else is kept verbatim; the file is removed only when nothing but the month heading is left; only a line matching the generated meta line is skipped
root_cause: Saving rebuilt the whole month file from only the entries parse() understood; parse also skipped any first body line starting with * as the meta line

detail: Window froze during journal loads/saves on OneDrive, starting Ask, and Strong's word lookups
error: Window froze during journal loads/saves on OneDrive, starting Ask, and Strong's word lookups
fix: Marked journal_list/save/delete, write_text_file, ask, strongs_for_word, strongs_by_book and strongs_verses #[tauri::command(async)] so they run on the thread pool
root_cause: Plain #[tauri::command] fns run on the main thread in Tauri v2; these do slow I/O (cloud-only vault files download on read, find() can run zsh -lc, full LIKE scans)

detail: Pressing Stop on an Ask answer froze the UI until the CLI finished shutting down
error: Pressing Stop on an Ask answer froze the UI until the CLI finished shutting down
fix: Running now holds pids, not the Child; the reader thread owns the Child and waits without any lock; cancel signals by pid
root_cause: The reader thread held the child's mutex while blocked in wait(); cancel needed the same mutex to kill it

detail: Ask could hang forever when the CLI wrote a lot to stderr
error: Ask could hang forever when the CLI wrote a lot to stderr
fix: assistant::spawn drains stderr on its own thread from the start; the text is joined only when an error message is needed
root_cause: stderr was piped but only read after stdout hit EOF; once the 64KB pipe buffer filled the CLI blocked writing and never closed stdout

detail: Claude/Codex processes (and their node/rg children) kept running after Stop or after quitting the app
error: Claude/Codex processes (and their node/rg children) kept running after Stop or after quitting the app
fix: CLIs are spawned with process_group(0); cancel and RunEvent::Exit send SIGTERM to the whole group via libc::kill(-pid)
root_cause: Child::kill only signals the direct child, and nothing killed running CLIs on exit

detail: write_text_file and the journal commands accepted any path, and ask's folder check could be escaped with ..
error: write_text_file and the journal commands accepted any path, and ask's folder check could be escaped with ..
fix: ask canonicalizes the folder and root before starts_with; journal dirs and write_text_file paths must be absolute with no .. ; write_text_file only writes non-dotfile .md/.txt/.html/.json
root_cause: Paths from the webview were used as given; ask compared un-normalised paths with starts_with, which .. components defeat

detail: Word Study resets to G25 every launch
error: Word Study resets to G25 every launch
fix: word kept in the stored place document; show() sets it, wordStudy derives from it, so go('word') and history keep the last word
root_cause: wordStudy was plain useState, never saved

detail: Bookmarks/highlights wiped after a failed store read
error: Bookmarks/highlights wiped after a failed store read
fix: useStored writes only after a successful read, queues pre-load changes and replays them onto the loaded value, and on a failed read never saves (console.error plus a toast)
root_cause: useStored fell back to defaults on read error and the next change saved them over the file; changes before the read wrote from the empty initial value

detail: Listen keeps reading the next chapter/page after Stop
error: Listen keeps reading the next chapter/page after Stop
fix: timer only speaks if g === gen.current; next-chapter load got a catch
root_cause: 600ms timer before the next chapter or page called speakFrom without checking the generation

detail: Play of a chapter can start after Stop or be overtaken by an older load
error: Play of a chapter can start after Stop or be overtaken by an older load
fix: take g = ++gen before the fetch, drop the result if gen moved, catch errors
root_cause: play() fetched the chapter with no generation check and no catch

detail: Unmarking a sequence plan day leaves its parts ticked
error: Unmarking a sequence plan day leaves its parts ticked
fix: compare against day:<last done index>, the day being unmarked
root_cause: unmarkDayRead computed the progress key while the day was still marked, so it pointed at the next day

detail: Last change lost on quit
error: Last change lost on quit
fix: pending writes tracked per document and flushed on beforeunload, blur and visibilitychange hidden; onCloseRequested not used because the JS listener would destroy the window the Rust side only hides
root_cause: 250ms debounced store writes were never flushed

detail: my_notes_file corrupted on journal round-trip; ***x*** shows asterisks
error: my_notes_file corrupted on journal round-trip; ***x*** shows asterisks
fix: _ italics only at word edges, *** bold italic and nested marks, backslash escapes read in mdToHtml and written by htmlToMd for * and edge _; mdPlain keeps in-word _
root_cause: inline Markdown treated _ as italic mid-word, had no *** form and htmlToMd did not escape marks typed as text

detail: See John 3:16 is not linked
error: See John 3:16 is not linked
fix: when findBook fails on a two-word name, retry with the last word and shift the match
root_cause: REF_RE took the capitalised word before the book as part of a two-word name, findBook rejected it

detail: Undo after removing a bookmark/recent drops items added since
error: Undo after removing a bookmark/recent drops items added since
fix: Undo re-inserts just the removed item at its old index if it is not already back
root_cause: Undo restored the whole old list

detail: Journal list can show the default folder instead of the chosen one at startup
error: Journal list can show the default folder instead of the chosen one at startup
fix: sequence counter; only the latest request's response is applied
root_cause: an older journalList response could land after a newer one

detail: Last day of a finished reading plan never counts as behind
error: Last day of a finished reading plan never counts as behind
fix: dueBefore (clamped to days.length) used by behind, skip catch-up and the missed list
root_cause: behind and missed-day lists used indexOn, clamped to days.length-1

detail: Book and study exports for Ask could end up half-written or mixed, with .complete marking a partial book folder
error: Book and study exports for Ask could end up half-written or mixed, with .complete marking a partial book folder
fix: store::dir_lock serialises exports per folder; store::replace_dir builds the contents in a .<name>.new sibling (books write .complete last) and renames it into place
root_cause: books::export and study::export deleted and rewrote their folder in place with no lock, so overlapping calls interleaved and a reader could see it mid-write

detail: Searches with non-ASCII letters in a different case (e.g. élie vs ÉLIE, Greek) found nothing or missed rows
error: Searches with non-ASCII letters in a different case (e.g. élie vs ÉLIE, Greek) found nothing or missed rows
fix: search::lower lowercases text and query the same way (char-wise Unicode, with a byte map back to the original for snippets; plain ASCII lowering when the query is ASCII, for speed); like_clause leaves non-ASCII words out of the LIKE prefilter (no prefilter at all for 'any')
root_cause: The query was lowercased with Unicode rules but the text with to_ascii_lowercase, and SQLite LIKE folds case only for ASCII, so the LIKE prefilter dropped rows too

root_cause: SMAppService.mainApp status is 3 (NotFound) for an app bundle that has never been registered, not only for the unbundled dev binary; backup-manager's pattern enabled the item only when status != NotFound
